## A Unified Runtime Exposure Management Solution

Reduce real-world cloud risk by combining vulnerability intelligence with deep runtime context,
protecting applications in production without slowing development.
[Learn More][86]
Code Security

### Prevent left with context from runtime

Identify exploitable vulnerabilities early and prioritize remediation based on real production
exposure, not theoretical severity.
Runtime Protection

### Prevent compromise where risk is realized

Stop known and unknown threats in live production environments, including AI-driven and prompt
injection attacks, using enforcement-first controls.
Posture Management

### See, prioritize, and remediate cloud and AI risks

Correlate vulnerabilities, runtime behavior and cloud context to reduce noise, accelerate
remediation and shorten mean time to protect.

### Runtime Exposure Management at Enterprise Scale

### Stay Secure with Aqua Trivy

The trusted open-source scanner for security professionals, delivering a powerful solution to
safeguard cloud-native applications. Driven by continuous contributions from a committed open-source
community, the highly accurate Aqua Trivy empowers you to maintain a strong security posture
[Aqua open-source][99]
Need to secure enterprise workloads?
Aqua Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP)
Go cloud native with the experts!
[Get Demo][100]
[Aqua Security][101]
Aqua Security is the pioneer in securing containerized cloud native applications from development to
production. Aqua's full lifecycle solution prevents attacks by enforcing pre-deployment hygiene and
mitigates attacks in real time in production, reducing mean time to repair and overall business
risk. The Aqua Platform, a Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP), integrates security
from Code to Cloud, combining the power of agent and agentless technology into a single solution.
With enterprise scale that doesn’t slow development pipelines, Aqua secures your future in the
cloud. Founded in 2015, Aqua is headquartered in Boston, MA and Ramat Gan, IL protecting over 500 of
the world’s largest enterprises.

Civolution has been recognized as the world leader in watermarking and fingerprinting based content
identification solutions. The company was formed in October 2008 as a spin-off of Royal Philips
Electronics, and was backed by Amsterdam-based VC firm Prime Ventures. In July 2009, Civolution
acquired the Software and Technology Solutions business from Thomson, formerly Nextamp, after which
the company created a portfolio of innovative solutions that ultimately formed its three business
units that were each divested separately:
* In December 2014, WPP's [Kantar Media][1] acquired Civolution's audio watermarking business
  supporting technology solutions for Audience Measurement and SyncNow, its Second Screen
  synchronization product.
* In July 2015, US data science and advertising technology company 4C Insights acquired Civolution's
  Teletrax business, owning the world's largest television broadcast monitoring networks supporting
  applications for TV Analytics and TV-synchronized digital advertising. Today Teletrax is part of
  [Kinetiq][2].
* And finally in July 2016, [Kudelski Group][3] acquired Civolution's market leading [NexGuard][4]
  Forensic Watermarking business supporting content tracking solutions for pre-release, digital
  cinema, pay TV and streaming.


The company has won over a dozen industry awards for its various product innovations, the last two
ones being the most prestigious of all:
* in January 2016 Civolution received a Technology & Engineering Emmy® Award for its Steganographic
  Technologies for Audio/Video
* in January 2018 Civolution received a Technology & Engineering Emmy® Award for its Video
  Identification Technology to Protect Content Value and Copyright

# Secure Your Future Secure Your Vision

[Discover More][179]

# NAGRA INSIGHT SMART PRICING

[Find out more][180]


## Welcome to NAGRAVISION

In a time of market disruption, NAGRAVISION will help you forge a path to success. We draw from more
than 30 years of experience with over 500 operators worldwide to create services and solutions that
succeed in protecting assets and supporting the ever-evolving business goals of our customer base
today.

From watermarking and anti-piracy solutions to streaming security, AI and analytics, we turn
entertainment and media technology into an engine of growth. Our solutions enable you to navigate a
dynamic environment to delight and retain existing subscribers, broaden the range of services
offered, discover new markets, and out-innovate the competition.


## Featured Products & Solutions

#### [Security Solutions][181]

Always-on, always-there security is core to our value proposition. It permeates our solutions and
gives you confidence that your content is always protected.

[ Find out more ][182]

#### [Streaming Solutions ][183]

Simplify the path to becoming a full-featured digital entertainment hub. Speed, efficiency, and
configuration are at the heart of a seamless streaming experience.

[ Find out more ][184]

#### [Subscriber Loyalty][185]

The power of data lies in the stories it tells. Digital twins – enriched by AI and designed for the
media and entertainment industry – give you the full picture on subscriber behavior.

[ Find out more ][186]

#### [Emerging Technologies][187]

Make sense of the disruption and future proof your business with media technology services that will
help your consumers thrive in their digital connected worlds.

[ Find out more ][188]

#### [Forensic Watermarking][189]

Combat piracy with the most powerful deterrent in the industry. Trace leaks back to the source and
protect valuable video and gaming content.

[ Find out more ][190]

#### [Anti-Piracy Services][191]

Piracy is popular, profitable, but preventable. Knowing who is stealing content or using operator
networks to distribute content illegally, gives you a crucial competitive advantage. 

[ Find out more ][192]

###### why us?

## The NAGRAVISION Difference

#### Market-Smart Techology

We combine cutting-edge technology with industry experience to deliver relevant solutions that
enable secure digital engagement. 

#### Engineering Excellence

Our Swiss roots and a focus on continuous innovation underpin our reputation for high-quality
industry–ready solutions.

#### Security First

As a pioneer in digital security, we help customers protect their content investments and help the
subscribers protect their connected worlds.

#### User-Centric

We focus on the consumer and creating- entertainment solutions that are easy to install, access, and
enjoy.

In a time of market disruption, NAGRAVISION will help you forge a path to success. We draw from more

succeed in protecting assets and supporting the ever-evolving business goals of our customer base
today.

entertainment and media technology into an engine of growth. Our solutions enable you to navigate a
dynamic environment to delight and retain existing subscribers, broaden the range of services
offered, discover new markets, and out-innovate the competition.

gives you confidence that your content is always protected.

TELUS initiated Project OPUS to transform Optik TV, simplifying content interaction. They chose
Verimatrix Streamkeeper for robust security.

[ Find out more ][75]

## Challenges
* Flexibility, scalability
* North American presence
* Adapting to existing tech

## Solution

TELUS partnered with Verimatrix for hybrid cloud security, cost-effectiveness, and geo-diverse
services.

##  Benefits
* Cost-effective hybrid cloud
* Scalable, geo-diverse service
* Strong collaboration/migration

## Little Cinema Secures Streams with Verimatrix

Little Cinema Digital partnered with Verimatrix to secure pre-release content and deliver engaging
virtual premieres using Streamkeeper Multi-DRM and Watermarking.

[ Find out more ][76]
[ Play video ][77]

## Challenges
* Pre-integrate into Backstage platform
* Scalable high-profile Hollywood events
* Met studio protection standards

## Solution

Verimatrix’s security technology allowed Little Cinema to stream highly-anticipated video content to
a global audience, shaping the future of Hollywood.

##  Benefits
* 3M+ simulcast viewers
* 450+ secure events
* 1.2M+ platform attendees

## Swisscom Enhances Content Security with Verimatrix

Swisscom migrates from on-premises security to Verimatrix’s Video Content Authority System (VCAS™)
SaaS in the cloud.

[ Find out more ][78]

## Challenges
* On premises migration to cloud
* Maintaining scalability requirements
* Future-proofing against piracy

## Solution

Swisscom transited to the Verimatrix VCAS SaaS on AWS, leveraging the advantages of scaleable,
cloud-based anti-piracy operations.

##  Benefits
* Operational efficiencies
* Reliability and customizability
* Improved customer satisfaction

simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**

  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments

* ## 02. Complete Your Registration

  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]

  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

Adaptive Recognition is the pioneering force in image processing technology, shaping the future of
smarter mobility and safer identity verification. Our suite of ANPR/LPR hardware and software and ID
& verification solutions optimise traffic flow, enhance access control, and secures identification. 

تُعد Adaptive Recognition قوة رائدة في تقنيات معالجة الصور، حيث تُسهم في تشكيل مستقبل التنقل الذكي
والتحقق الآمن من الهوية. تعمل حلولنا من الأجهزة والبرمجيات الخاصة بالتعرف على لوحات المركبات (التعرف
التلقائي على لوحات الأرقام / التعرف على لوحات الأرقام) وحلول قراءة الهوية والتحقق منها على تحسين حركة
المرور، وتعزيز التحكم في الوصول، وتأمين التعرف على الهويات.

Adaptive Recognition to pionier w technologii przetwarzania obrazu, kształtujący przyszłość
inteligentnej mobilności i bezpiecznej weryfikacji tożsamości. Nasze rozwiązania sprzętowe i
programowe do automatycznego rozpoznawania tablic rejestracyjnych (ANPR/LPR – automatyczne
rozpoznawanie tablic / odczyt tablic) oraz systemy odczytu i weryfikacji tożsamości usprawniają
przepływ ruchu, zwiększają kontrolę dostępu i zapewniają bezpieczną identyfikację.

Adaptive Recognition je priekopníckou silou v oblasti technológií spracovania obrazu, formujúcou
budúcnosť inteligentnej mobility a bezpečnej overovania identity. Naša ponuka hardvéru a softvéru
ANPR/LPR a riešení na overovanie ID optimalizuje tok dopravy, zlepšuje kontrolu prístupu a
zabezpečuje identifikáciu.

Az Adaptive Recognition úttörő szerepet tölt be a jármű- és okmányazonosítási technológiák
területén, támogatva a közlekedési folyamatok hatékony működését és a megbízható
személyazonosság-ellenőrzést. Rendszámfelismerő hardver- és szoftvermegoldásaink, valamint
okmányolvasási és ellenőrzési technológiáink optimalizálják a forgalmat, egyszerűsítik a
beléptetést, és gyors, pontos személyazonosítást tesznek lehetővé.

We develop and license proprietary audio watermarking and acoustic fingerprinting software for
commercial and professional use. The patented[*][7] technologies are available as robust,
cross-platform DSP solutions and services — from server-side tools to real-time streaming SDKs.

These technologies enable professionals and organizations to:
* trace leaks and deter piracy through forensic watermarking
* authenticate recordings and prove content provenance
* mark and disclose AI-generated or AI-manipulated audio
* monitor broadcasts, recognize music, and synchronize playback
* embed invisible data into audio for signaling, licensing, and DRM
* de-duplicate large audio libraries using acoustic fingerprinting

We develop and license proprietary audio watermarking and acoustic fingerprinting software for
commercial and professional use. The patented[*][7] technologies are available as robust,
cross-platform DSP solutions and services — from server-side tools to real-time streaming SDKs.

These technologies enable professionals and organizations to:
* trace leaks and deter piracy through forensic watermarking
* authenticate recordings and prove content provenance
* mark and disclose AI-generated or AI-manipulated audio
* monitor broadcasts, recognize music, and synchronize playback
* embed invisible data into audio for signaling, licensing, and DRM
* de-duplicate large audio libraries using acoustic fingerprinting

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

Security Assessment
Managed Security

Founded by James Swierczewski, Beginners in AI is the #1 resource for non-technical professionals

## What is Beginners in AI?

Beginners in AI is a learning library and daily newsletter for non-technical people who want to use
AI well. We are not a research blog. We are not an AI hype account. We explain AI tools, workflows,
and ideas in plain English, with a daily newsletter that hands you one new tool or technique each
morning.

## Who is Beginners in AI for?

People who are curious but not technical. Professionals (teachers, lawyers, doctors, real estate
agents, founders, parents) who want to use AI well in their work without becoming an AI engineer.
Curious learners who heard ChatGPT or Claude was a big deal and want to understand it for
themselves.

## How much does Beginners in AI cost?

The website, the newsletter, the AI glossary, the tool directory, and the Start Here learning path
are free. Special Reports are also free. A small set of products (advanced workshops, [1-on-1
coaching][84]) are paid and clearly labeled. No paywall on the daily content.

Three differences. First, every story in the newsletter is human-curated from primary sources
(Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Stanford AI Index, Pew, McKinsey). Most “daily AI” newsletters
now summarize 30 RSS feeds with GPT. We do not. Second, the content library is built for beginners
specifically, with practical examples that go beyond surface-level use cases. Third, we are
independent. No corporate sponsor and no AI vendor relationship that shapes coverage. Newsletter
sponsor slots in Beehiiv are paid per click and have no bearing on what we cover or how we cover it.

## How often does the newsletter ship?

Every morning, seven days a week. One issue per day, around a 5-minute read. Weekends included so
you never lose the thread.

## What do you get with the daily newsletter?

A short read each morning covering one notable story, one tool worth knowing, and one practical tip.
No paywall, no upsells, no AI-generated aggregator content. Just one human-edited briefing to start
the day.

Beginners in AI is a learning library and daily newsletter for non-technical people who want to use

## Who is Beginners in AI for?

People who are curious but not technical. Professionals (teachers, lawyers, doctors, real estate
agents, founders, parents) who want to use AI well in their work without becoming an AI engineer.
Curious learners who heard ChatGPT or Claude was a big deal and want to understand it for

independent. No corporate sponsor and no AI vendor relationship that shapes coverage. Newsletter
sponsor slots in Beehiiv are paid per click and have no bearing on what we cover or how we cover it.

Every morning, seven days a week. One issue per day, around a 5-minute read. Weekends included so
you never lose the thread.

# Content Security Platform for Streaming Video

Providing Digital Rights Management (DRM) and Watermarking Solutions that enable the highest levels
of protection for premium video content across the globe.
Contact Us
][30]

## Content Security Services & Solutions

### Digital Rights Management

Support for Microsoft PlayReady, Apple FairPlay, and Google Widevine studio-approved DRM. Offered as
a Service, a Solution, and a hybrid Managed Service. BuyDRM's feature rich MultiKey Service powers
many of today's most prominent brands.

### Forensic Watermarking

Watermarking offers the highest level of protection available for your most premium content. With
support for both Live Streaming and VOD (Video on Demand), Forensic Watermarking enables the unique
identification of pirates and other bad actors.

### Complementary DRM Technologies

Built in-house to the strictest security standards possible, choose from basic command line
packagers to a dynamic, just-in-time packager, streaming, and origin server for streaming of content
protected with DRM. Top it off with an HTML5 Player specifically built with Digital Rights
Management in mind.

## Supporting All the Most Popular Business Models

We employ a unique APl-driven approach that supports all streaming video business logics like – Live
Streaming, Advertising Video on Demand (AVOD), Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (FAST),
Subscription Video on Demand (SVOD), TV Everywhere (TVE), Pay Per View (PPV), and Premium Video on
Demand (PVOD) across all major playback platforms like Roku, Amazon FireTV, iPadOS, Android, iOS,
Windows, OS X, TVOS, SamsungTV+, Hulu, Tizen, LG WebOS, Set Top Boxes (STBs), and more.

## Providing Content Protection for Leading Brands Worldwide

[ KeyOS ESP Partner Program ][31]

### Content Security Partners: KeyOS ESP Partner Program

At BuyDRM, we understand the importance of having great partners and the value strategic
integrations bring to companies deploying premium video offerings. The KeyOS ESP program aims to
align partner technologies with the KeyOS Encryption Key and License Key APIs so that mutual clients
can utilize the technologies in parallel as they deploy.
 
If you already use or plan to use one of our ESP partners, deploying your video content security
strategy couldn’t be easier. Our technical team fully validates all our partner integrations and
ensures they are always up to date. View our partner list to see what vendors have integrated their
solutions with the KeyOS Content Security platform.

# Content Security Platform for Streaming Video

Providing Digital Rights Management (DRM) and Watermarking Solutions that enable the highest levels
of protection for premium video content across the globe.
Contact Us
][30]

## Content Security Services & Solutions

### Digital Rights Management

Support for Microsoft PlayReady, Apple FairPlay, and Google Widevine studio-approved DRM. Offered as
a Service, a Solution, and a hybrid Managed Service. BuyDRM's feature rich MultiKey Service powers
many of today's most prominent brands.

### Forensic Watermarking

Watermarking offers the highest level of protection available for your most premium content. With
support for both Live Streaming and VOD (Video on Demand), Forensic Watermarking enables the unique
identification of pirates and other bad actors.

### Complementary DRM Technologies

Built in-house to the strictest security standards possible, choose from basic command line
packagers to a dynamic, just-in-time packager, streaming, and origin server for streaming of content
protected with DRM. Top it off with an HTML5 Player specifically built with Digital Rights
Management in mind.

## Supporting All the Most Popular Business Models

We employ a unique APl-driven approach that supports all streaming video business logics like – Live
Streaming, Advertising Video on Demand (AVOD), Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (FAST),
Subscription Video on Demand (SVOD), TV Everywhere (TVE), Pay Per View (PPV), and Premium Video on
Demand (PVOD) across all major playback platforms like Roku, Amazon FireTV, iPadOS, Android, iOS,
Windows, OS X, TVOS, SamsungTV+, Hulu, Tizen, LG WebOS, Set Top Boxes (STBs), and more.

## Providing Content Protection for Leading Brands Worldwide

[ KeyOS ESP Partner Program ][31]

### Content Security Partners: KeyOS ESP Partner Program

At BuyDRM, we understand the importance of having great partners and the value strategic
integrations bring to companies deploying premium video offerings. The KeyOS ESP program aims to
align partner technologies with the KeyOS Encryption Key and License Key APIs so that mutual clients
can utilize the technologies in parallel as they deploy.
 
If you already use or plan to use one of our ESP partners, deploying your video content security
strategy couldn’t be easier. Our technical team fully validates all our partner integrations and
ensures they are always up to date. View our partner list to see what vendors have integrated their
solutions with the KeyOS Content Security platform.

## We help Organisations to Innovate

### “Robin Rocks the Real Estate AI Agents”

Digital Bricks has developed Robin Rocks, an AI-powered real estate agent that transforms the
property description process. By leveraging over 180 data points, Robin Rocks reduces the time
required to create detailed property descriptions from six hours to just ten minutes, optimizing
efficiency and accuracy in real estate transactions.

Roger Berger

Co-founder Robin Rocks

### “Direct Impact for Our Actos Talent Pool”

Digital Bricks has truly set a new standard with their bespoke AI HR & Recruitment Training. The
tailored approach they provided has significantly enhanced our team's capabilities, allowing us to
streamline our recruitment processes and make more informed decisions based on AI. Their expertise
and dedication to understanding our unique needs have made a direct impact on our talent pool, and
the young students where leveraging AI the next day.

Jelmer Storm

Operational Manager at Resulta at Groep

### “Ask Nova”

Digital Bricks provided strategic guidance to noventum in the development of Nova, the service
knowledge retrieval agent. Their expertise in AI and digital transformation was instrumental in
shaping Nova's capabilities, ensuring it effectively meets the needs of users.

Hilbrand Rustema

Managing Director at Noventum

### “The Core of Our Business”

Partnering with Digital Bricks to develop the Finnish Copilot Adoption Accelerator has been a
transformative journey. Together, we developed an innovative program that empowers organisations in
Finland to seamlessly integrate Copilot into their workflows. It has been a pleasure working with
Max, Jamie and the team.

Juho Yli-Siplä

AI Trainer at Sinuntekoaly

### Empowering Our Teachers and Students

Working alongside Digital Bricks was incredibly insightful. Their expertise in AI education helped
us introduce AI concepts to our students in an engaging and accessible way. Beyond inspiring the
students, Digital Bricks also empowered our teaching team with the knowledge and tools to design
AI-driven lesson plans, making curriculum development more innovative and future-ready. Their
approach is truly reshaping how we incorporate emerging technologies in education.

Bethany Johnson

Teacher & Wellbeing Coordinator at Deira International School, Dubai.

### A Seamless and Impactful AI Partnership

Bringing AI into organizations isn’t just about technology, it’s about making it work in the right
way for the right people. That’s exactly what Digital Bricks helped us achieve with the Finnish
Copilot Adoption Accelerator. Their ability to tailor global strategies to fit Finland’s unique
business culture and operational needs was exceptional. From the very beginning, Max, Jamie, and the
team were proactive, insightful, and incredibly easy to work with. Their structured yet flexible
approach ensured that Copilot integration wasn’t just theoretical but practical and impactful for
Finnish organisations.

Kari Angeria

Co-Founder & CEO at Sinun Tekoäly

### Digital Bricks Transformed How We Use AI in PR

Working with Digital Bricks was a pivot point for us. They helped us rethink how we use AI in PR.
With their guidance, we developed an internal ChatGPT-powered assistant that connects to our
business data, making our workflows faster and more efficient. What really stood out was the
hands-on training. They made AI feel understandable, showing our team exactly how to use it to
streamline tasks and enhance our work.

Gabriella Franchi

Operations Manager, PRLab

### AI Strategy for Deira International School

Digital Bricks played a key role in shaping our AI strategy, the team helped us turn AI from a
concept into a practical, scalable tool for education. Their expertise and hands-on approach ensured
our strategy aligns with both curriculum needs and long-term goals. Thanks to their guidance, we now
have a clear roadmap to integrate AI effectively across our schools. A fantastic partnership!

Kieran Birrell

Educational Technology Lead & Head of Computing at Al-Futtaim Education Foundation

### Digital Bricks Inspired Us

We have certainly been inspired by the possibilities that AI can offer for Tuinte. We are now
thinking about how and when we are going to start with AI. We're sure we want to do these steps with
Digital Bricks. Max and his Team are true experts.

Maartje Reekers

HR Manager at Tuinte

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

# The world's most effective anti-piracy solutions.

#### Take the fight to the pirates and win back your revenue, with the fastest, smartest and most
#### effective content security and [anti-piracy solutions][44] available.

[ Our solutions ][45]

### Fighting back against piracy

[Friend MTS' cybersecurity and anti-piracy solutions][46] help you reduce churn, uncover new revenue
streams and engage with diverted audiences. They are built on two decades of extensive data capture
and expert analysis, and keep you ahead of the pirates. 

##### Data: your greatest weapon

When piracy is your biggest competitor, data-driven solutions provide the key to winning back
revenue from the pirates. FMTS services are built on the most comprehensive piracy database in the
world, comprising millions of entries. This unrivalled source of piracy knowledge is constantly
augmented and updated by proprietary systems designed specifically to track and define the piracy
landscape. Our class-leading cybersecurity solutions provide proven results and are trusted by major
brands in sport, media and entertainment. 

[Monitor]

## Monitor

When your content is stolen, finding it quickly, wherever it is, is critical to stopping piracy –
and protecting your revenues.

[ Start with Monitor ][47]
[Identify]

## Identify

Tracing piracy back to its source and identifying vulnerabilities, compromised subscriptions and
distribution paths are key steps in the fight to win back revenue from pirates.

[ Identify the source ][48]
[Disrupt]

## Disrupt

Take down the pirates, disrupt their operations, block their audiences – and see your revenues
increase.

[ Time to Disrupt ][49]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to the most common questions about our AI watermark remover.

### What are AI watermarks?

AI watermarks are invisible characters (like zero-width spaces) that AI tools like ChatGPT insert
into generated text. These hidden markers help identify AI-generated content but don't affect
readability.

### How does the watermark removal tool work?

Our tool scans your text for invisible characters commonly used as AI watermarks, such as zero-width
spaces and ASCII control characters. It then highlights these markers and can remove them completely
while preserving your original content.

### Is my text stored or logged?

No. All text processing happens directly in your browser. We don't store, log, or transmit your text
anywhere. Your privacy is our priority.

### What types of watermarks can be detected?

We detect various invisible characters including zero-width spaces, zero-width joiners, soft
hyphens, word joiners, and ASCII control characters that AI tools might use as watermarks.

### Will removing watermarks affect my text?

No. The tool only removes invisible characters used as watermarks. Your visible text, formatting,
and meaning remain exactly the same.

### Is there a character limit?

Yes, the free version currently has a 500-character limit per operation. Signed-in users get 1,500
characters. This helps ensure fast processing and optimal performance.

### Can I clean watermarks from Word documents?

Yes! You can upload Word (.docx) documents directly to our tool. We'll scan and remove invisible
watermark characters from all sections including main content, headers, footers, footnotes, and
comments—all while preserving your document's formatting and layout. Processing happens entirely in
your browser, so your documents remain private.

### Can I clean watermarks from Apple Pages documents?

Yes! You can upload Apple Pages (.pages) documents directly to our tool. We support both modern and
legacy Pages formats. We'll scan and remove invisible watermark characters from your entire document
while preserving all formatting, styles, and layout. All processing happens locally in your browser,
ensuring your documents stay completely private.

### How secure is document processing? Do my documents leave my device?

Your documents are 100% secure and never leave your device. All document processing happens entirely
in your browser using JavaScript. When you upload a Word or Pages document, it's read and modified
locally on your computer—we never send your files to any server. This means your sensitive
documents, personal information, and private content remain completely confidential. Even we can't
see what you're processing. This client-side approach ensures maximum privacy and security for your
documents.

### Why does my cleaned document still show watermarks when I copy the text?

If you clean a document using our document uploader and then copy-paste the text into the text
detection area, you might see watermarks detected. This is normal and doesn't mean the cleaning
failed. Here's why: Document cleaning preserves all formatting (bold, italics, spacing, etc.) to
keep your document looking identical. When you copy this formatted text, some harmless formatting
characters (like special spaces or unicode formatting marks) come along. Our text detection tool,
which is designed to be more aggressive, might flag these formatting characters as potential
watermarks. The document itself is clean—these are just formatting artifacts from the copy-paste
process, not actual AI watermarks. For best results, use the cleaned document directly rather than
copy-pasting its content.

### What is a zero-width character and why do AI tools use them?

Zero-width characters are invisible Unicode characters that take up no visual space but exist in the

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to the most common questions about our AI watermark remover.

### What are AI watermarks?

AI watermarks are invisible characters (like zero-width spaces) that AI tools like ChatGPT insert
into generated text. These hidden markers help identify AI-generated content but don't affect
readability.

### How does the watermark removal tool work?

Our tool scans your text for invisible characters commonly used as AI watermarks, such as zero-width
spaces and ASCII control characters. It then highlights these markers and can remove them completely
while preserving your original content.

### Is my text stored or logged?

No. All text processing happens directly in your browser. We don't store, log, or transmit your text
anywhere. Your privacy is our priority.

### What types of watermarks can be detected?

We detect various invisible characters including zero-width spaces, zero-width joiners, soft
hyphens, word joiners, and ASCII control characters that AI tools might use as watermarks.

### Will removing watermarks affect my text?

No. The tool only removes invisible characters used as watermarks. Your visible text, formatting,
and meaning remain exactly the same.

### Is there a character limit?

Yes, the free version currently has a 500-character limit per operation. Signed-in users get 1,500
characters. This helps ensure fast processing and optimal performance.

### Can I clean watermarks from Word documents?

Yes! You can upload Word (.docx) documents directly to our tool. We'll scan and remove invisible
watermark characters from all sections including main content, headers, footers, footnotes, and
comments—all while preserving your document's formatting and layout. Processing happens entirely in
your browser, so your documents remain private.

### Can I clean watermarks from Apple Pages documents?

Yes! You can upload Apple Pages (.pages) documents directly to our tool. We support both modern and
legacy Pages formats. We'll scan and remove invisible watermark characters from your entire document
while preserving all formatting, styles, and layout. All processing happens locally in your browser,
ensuring your documents stay completely private.

### How secure is document processing? Do my documents leave my device?

Your documents are 100% secure and never leave your device. All document processing happens entirely
in your browser using JavaScript. When you upload a Word or Pages document, it's read and modified
locally on your computer—we never send your files to any server. This means your sensitive
documents, personal information, and private content remain completely confidential. Even we can't
see what you're processing. This client-side approach ensures maximum privacy and security for your
documents.

### Why does my cleaned document still show watermarks when I copy the text?

If you clean a document using our document uploader and then copy-paste the text into the text
detection area, you might see watermarks detected. This is normal and doesn't mean the cleaning
failed. Here's why: Document cleaning preserves all formatting (bold, italics, spacing, etc.) to
keep your document looking identical. When you copy this formatted text, some harmless formatting
characters (like special spaces or unicode formatting marks) come along. Our text detection tool,
which is designed to be more aggressive, might flag these formatting characters as potential
watermarks. The document itself is clean—these are just formatting artifacts from the copy-paste
process, not actual AI watermarks. For best results, use the cleaned document directly rather than
copy-pasting its content.

## Frequently Asked Questions About AI Watermarks

### What is a ChatGPT watermark?

A **ChatGPT watermark** is a hidden pattern of characters or subtle text modifications that OpenAI
may embed in ChatGPT-generated content. These watermarks are designed to be invisible to humans but
detectable by specialized tools. They often include **zero-width characters** and other invisible
unicode characters.

### Does ChatGPT add watermarks to its text?

While OpenAI has discussed the possibility of **watermarking AI-generated text**, the exact
implementation and prevalence of watermarks in ChatGPT outputs remains partially undisclosed. Our
tool is designed to detect and remove potential watermarking techniques, including those using
**invisible unicode characters**.

### How does this watermark remover work?

Our **AI watermark remover** scans text for known patterns of **invisible characters** used in
watermarking, including **zero-width spaces**, **zero-width joiners**, and other unicode characters.
It then removes these characters while preserving the visible text content.

### Is it legal to remove AI watermarks?

Removing **invisible characters** from text is generally legal for personal use. However, always
ensure you comply with the terms of service of the AI platforms you're using, and properly attribute
AI-generated content when required.

### Do other AI tools like Claude or Bard use watermarks?

Various AI companies may implement different watermarking techniques. Our tool is designed to detect
and remove a wide range of potential **AI watermarking methods**, including those that might be used
by **Claude**, **Bard**, and other AI text generators.

### How to Remove Em Dashes from ChatGPT?

ChatGPT and other AI systems often generate text with various types of em dashes (—, ⸺, ⸻) that can
affect readability. Our tool makes it easy to handle these dashes:

**Step 1:** Paste your ChatGPT-generated text into the input box above.

**Step 2:** Check the **"Handle em dashes"** option in the settings.

**Step 3:** Choose your preferred method:
* **Replace:** Converts em dashes to regular dashes (— → -, ⸺ → --, ⸻ → ---)
* **Remove:** Completely removes em dashes and adds proper spacing between words

**Step 4:** Click **"Clean Text"** and your text will be processed automatically. The tool
intelligently handles multiple consecutive dashes and prevents words from running together when
dashes are removed.

POURQUOI LIORA ?

## Le futur ne se prédit pas.
## Il se crée, ensemble.

### Prenez le contrôle
### et créez votre propre avenir

Certains regardent le futur. D’autres l’écrivent, ligne par ligne. Liora est plus qu’une école :
c’est un manifeste. Celui d’une génération qui refuse d’attendre que les choses changent, et choisit
de les transformer. Notre pédagogie, nos mentors, nos partenaires : tout est pensé pour
l’excellence, tout est fait pour vous propulser.

### Rejoignez ceux qui façonnent notre futur

Intégrez un collectif d’exception, porté par l’innovation continue, les nouvelles technologies et
l’engagement total de nos formateurs experts. Vous progressez dans un écosystème rare : exigeant,
stimulant, profondément humain. Ici, chaque réussite est célébrée, chaque ambition encouragée. Vous
ne courez pas après le futur. Vous le façonnez.

### Prenez place,
### le futur vous attend

Chez Liora, chaque parcours est une trajectoire vers l’emploi, portée par l’excellence de nos
contenus, la puissance de notre réseau et l’engagement total de nos équipes. Vous avancez avec les
bons outils, dans le bon cadre, entouré des bons contacts, vers un avenir à la hauteur de vos
ambitions.

un avenir commun, plusieurs voies possibles

Formez vos équipes, recrutez vos talents, façonnez l’avenir technologique de votre entreprise.

The deterministic document platform

# Your critical document workflows can’t run on a guess

Nutrient is the deterministic document infrastructure enterprises run their highest-stakes workflows
on: replayable output, clear exceptions, and full audit trails on the messy, regulated documents
where AI alone breaks. Use any AI model, your own, or none, and keep every document inside your
environment.

[ See it in action ][60] [ Talk to an expert ][61]
Used by Red Bull, IBM, Docusign, Box, Austrian Government, CMiC

THE TRUST GAP

## Intelligence is easy. Reliable intelligence is hard.

Reading a document is where it begins. AI can summarize, classify, and extract. Enterprise workflows
can’t act on a guess. When you need to trust the output in a regulated, audited, high-stakes
workflow, Nutrient prevents your project from stalling.

~40%

of document AI projects underperform their ROI projections

60–80%

of enterprise data is unstructured

70%

cite trust and data quality as barriers to scaling AI

WHY IT BREAKS AT SCALE

## The first 75 percent got easy.
## The last 25 percent is where you want Nutrient.

AI made implementing open source faster and more accessible. But true enterprise workflows are
defined by the last mile of the most difficult documents with the smallest margin for error:
provable extraction, compliance, reliability, and rendering fidelity. That’s what Nutrient was built
for.

01
[ Data extraction ][75]

The demo

A clean invoice parses fine.

The reality

A dense table or a 200-page contract returns confident, wrong values. Nothing flags it.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient returns structured data with per-field confidence and an audit trail. Identical every run.

[ Explore ][76]
02

Reliability at scale

The demo

One document is a demo.

The reality

A million a day brings exceptions, rework, and output that drifts from one run to the next.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient runs deterministically at scale. Identical, auditable output on every document.

[ Explore ][77]
03

Rendering fidelity

The demo

Most viewers handle a clean PDF.

The reality

Malformed files, scans, CAD drawings, and thousand-page documents still have to render exactly, on
every device.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient renders on the same engine as Chrome. Pixel-accurate on the files that break open source.

[ Explore ][78]
04

Compliance and accessibility

The demo

Auto-tagging gets you started.

The reality

Auto-tags pass a checker but fail real review. PDF/UA and PDF/A aren’t optional in regulated work.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient produces genuinely compliant PDF/UA and PDF/A. Accessible and audit-ready, not just tagged.

[ Explore ][79]
05

Conversion

The demo

Office to PDF looks simple.

The reality

Fonts, layout, and pagination drift between machines. The file looks right until it doesn’t.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient preserves fonts, layout, and pagination exactly. The same document everywhere it opens.

[ Explore ][80]
06

Redaction

The demo

A black box over text looks redacted.

The reality

The text still sits under the box, recoverable by copy-paste. The metadata leaks with it.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient truly removes the underlying data and its metadata, with an audit trail of what was
redacted.

[ Explore ][81]

THE PLATFORM

## One platform, the whole document workflow

From a raw document to a governed outcome, with agents and people working the same pipeline.

Extract and structure

Turn any document into structured, auditable data: OCR, classification, key-value pairs, and tables.

Generate and convert

Create, convert, and render documents at scale, with high-fidelity output.

Govern and route

Conditional routing, approvals, and audit trails, or keep AI out of it entirely.

Review and approve

Review, edit, annotate, redact, and sign in the real rendered document.

Deploy anywhere

Cloud, self-hosted, or air-gapped. Embed via SDKs, APIs, or an MCP server.

WHY NUTRIENT

## Deterministic by design, governed for the enterprise

Reliable outputs you can audit. Governed workflows you can prove. Purpose-built interfaces bring
humans into the loop at the moments where judgment matters most. Built on 20+ years of document
expertise.

Handle the documents that break everything else: handwritten, scanned, exception-filled.
High-fidelity, auditable output where accuracy matters most.

out. Run any model, even private, so data never leaves your environment.

THE TRUST GAP

## Intelligence is easy. Reliable intelligence is hard.

Reading a document is where it begins. AI can summarize, classify, and extract. Enterprise workflows
can’t act on a guess. When you need to trust the output in a regulated, audited, high-stakes
workflow, Nutrient prevents your project from stalling.

WHY IT BREAKS AT SCALE

## The first 75 percent got easy.
## The last 25 percent is where you want Nutrient.

AI made implementing open source faster and more accessible. But true enterprise workflows are
defined by the last mile of the most difficult documents with the smallest margin for error:
provable extraction, compliance, reliability, and rendering fidelity. That’s what Nutrient was built
for.

The reality

A dense table or a 200-page contract returns confident, wrong values. Nothing flags it.

Nutrient returns structured data with per-field confidence and an audit trail. Identical every run.

Reliability at scale

The demo

One document is a demo.

The reality

A million a day brings exceptions, rework, and output that drifts from one run to the next.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient runs deterministically at scale. Identical, auditable output on every document.

[ Explore ][77]
03

Rendering fidelity

The demo

Most viewers handle a clean PDF.

The reality

Malformed files, scans, CAD drawings, and thousand-page documents still have to render exactly, on
every device.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient renders on the same engine as Chrome. Pixel-accurate on the files that break open source.

[ Explore ][78]

Compliance and accessibility

The demo

Auto-tagging gets you started.

The reality

Auto-tags pass a checker but fail real review. PDF/UA and PDF/A aren’t optional in regulated work.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient produces genuinely compliant PDF/UA and PDF/A. Accessible and audit-ready, not just tagged.

[ Explore ][79]
05

Conversion

The demo

Office to PDF looks simple.

The reality

Fonts, layout, and pagination drift between machines. The file looks right until it doesn’t.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient preserves fonts, layout, and pagination exactly. The same document everywhere it opens.

[ Explore ][80]
06

Redaction

The demo

A black box over text looks redacted.

The reality

The text still sits under the box, recoverable by copy-paste. The metadata leaks with it.

WITH NUTRIENT

Nutrient truly removes the underlying data and its metadata, with an audit trail of what was
redacted.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

## Are you an OWASP Member?

Join or renew your OWASP Membership today to continue supporting our mission of making software
security visible, so that individuals and organizations worldwide can make informed decisions about
true software security risks. Lifetime Membership is due to increase on January 1, 2027, so act now
to lock in the current rate!

[More details][10]

[[BASC 2026]][11]

Application Security practitioners, software engineers, and researchers from all over the world
gather at OWASP’s BASC conferences to discover, present and discuss the latest developments in
software security, collaborate with their peers, and share the newest innovations in the field.

The conference will take place on April 11, 2026 in Boston, MA The event will also offer hands-on
training with vetted and leading trainers on the same day.

[Register today!][12]

## 7ASecurity Platinum Corporate Supporter

OWASP Platinum Corporate Supporter. We go over 7ASecurity’s community resources available to all
security researchers, their contributions to the OWASP OWTF project, and many other topics.

More details, including how 7ASecurity’s audit process works can be found in the [video][14]

## It’s our 25th Anniversary! Get ready for an unforgettable experience at the OWASP Global AppSec
## EU Conference!

From June 22-26, 2026, join over 800 cybersecurity experts at the legendary Austria Center in
Vienna, Austria for an event like no other. This year’s reimagined conference promises to ignite
your passion for security with world class keynotes, newly designed tracks , OWASP Project Demo’s,
interactive PODS, and MobileAppSecCon.

But that’s just the beginning! Explore the vibrant exhibitor hall and sharpen your skills through
the interactive Meet the Mentor Program, How to write a CfP, and heart-pounding Capture the Flag
challenge. Plus, you’ll have endless chances to connect with fellow security professionals at our
exclusive networking receptions.

Want to take your expertise even further? Don’t miss out on hands-on training opportunities,
available for one, two, or three days, running from June 22-24. It’s your chance to level up your
knowledge and skills in an immersive, high-energy environment.

[Register Today!][16]

# Explore the world
# of cyber security

Driven by volunteers, OWASP resources are accessible for everyone.

[[Are you an OWASP Member?]][9]

## Are you an OWASP Member?

Join or renew your OWASP Membership today to continue supporting our mission of making software
security visible, so that individuals and organizations worldwide can make informed decisions about
true software security risks. Lifetime Membership is due to increase on January 1, 2027, so act now
to lock in the current rate!

[More details][10]

[[BASC 2026]][11]

Application Security practitioners, software engineers, and researchers from all over the world
gather at OWASP’s BASC conferences to discover, present and discuss the latest developments in
software security, collaborate with their peers, and share the newest innovations in the field.

The conference will take place on April 11, 2026 in Boston, MA The event will also offer hands-on
training with vetted and leading trainers on the same day.

[Register today!][12]

[[7A Security Interview]][13]

## 7ASecurity Platinum Corporate Supporter

In this wide-ranging interview with Abraham Aranguren, Managing Director of 7ASecurity, who is an
OWASP Platinum Corporate Supporter. We go over 7ASecurity’s community resources available to all
security researchers, their contributions to the OWASP OWTF project, and many other topics.

More details, including how 7ASecurity’s audit process works can be found in the [video][14]

[[OWASP Global Appsec EU Conference 2026]][15]

## It’s our 25th Anniversary! Get ready for an unforgettable experience at the OWASP Global AppSec
## EU Conference!

From June 22-26, 2026, join over 800 cybersecurity experts at the legendary Austria Center in
Vienna, Austria for an event like no other. This year’s reimagined conference promises to ignite
your passion for security with world class keynotes, newly designed tracks , OWASP Project Demo’s,
interactive PODS, and MobileAppSecCon.

But that’s just the beginning! Explore the vibrant exhibitor hall and sharpen your skills through
the interactive Meet the Mentor Program, How to write a CfP, and heart-pounding Capture the Flag
challenge. Plus, you’ll have endless chances to connect with fellow security professionals at our
exclusive networking receptions.

Want to take your expertise even further? Don’t miss out on hands-on training opportunities,
available for one, two, or three days, running from June 22-24. It’s your chance to level up your
knowledge and skills in an immersive, high-energy environment.

[Register Today!][16]

## [OWASP CVE Lite CLI Graduates to Lab Project Status][17]

[image]

Sonu Kapoor, July 6, 2026

CVE Lite CLI, a fast open source dependency vulnerability scanner for JavaScript and TypeScript
projects, has graduated to OWASP Lab Project status three months after its initial release.

Features

## How is
## Pangram different?

There are many AI detectors available, but Pangram is different. It actually works. We also provide
advanced features backed by peer-reviewed research that allow users to understand the origin of a
piece of writing.

### Years of research

Uses proprietary technology with years of research and development behind it, not an open source
model or commercial LLMs covered with branding.

### Trained on diverse data sets

Pangram relies on diverse datasets, hard negative mining, and active learning to achieve
industry-leading FPRs rather than perplexity and burstiness, which often fail in practice.

### Detects all LLMs

Pangram can detect content from all major language models including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama
and more, making it a comprehensive solution for AI detection.

### Supports 20+ languages

Our AI detection works across more than 20 languages, making it a truly global, multilingual
solution for institutions and businesses worldwide.

### Out-performed trained humans

Independent studies have shown that Pangram's AI detection outperforms trained human readers in
identifying AI-generated content.

### Detects humanized text

Pangram can detect AI-generated text even after it has been "humanized," or processed by tools that
attempt to evade AI detection, ensuring reliable detection.

### Verified accuracy

Our accuracy and reliability have been [independently verified][26] by third-party researchers and
educational institutions.

## Pangram Labs

Features

## How is
## Pangram different?

There are many AI detectors available, but Pangram is different. It actually works. We also provide
advanced features backed by peer-reviewed research that allow users to understand the origin of a
piece of writing.

### Years of research

Uses proprietary technology with years of research and development behind it, not an open source
model or commercial LLMs covered with branding.

### Trained on diverse data sets

Pangram relies on diverse datasets, hard negative mining, and active learning to achieve
industry-leading FPRs rather than perplexity and burstiness, which often fail in practice.

### Detects all LLMs

Pangram can detect content from all major language models including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama
and more, making it a comprehensive solution for AI detection.

### Supports 20+ languages

Our AI detection works across more than 20 languages, making it a truly global, multilingual
solution for institutions and businesses worldwide.

### Out-performed trained humans

Independent studies have shown that Pangram's AI detection outperforms trained human readers in
identifying AI-generated content.

### Detects humanized text

Pangram can detect AI-generated text even after it has been "humanized," or processed by tools that
attempt to evade AI detection, ensuring reliable detection.

### Verified accuracy

Our accuracy and reliability have been [independently verified][26] by third-party researchers and
educational institutions.

With Progressive, you can take your boat to any lake or river, plus ocean waters within 75 miles of
the coast. And we offer a variety of coverages to protect your boat and the good times that come
with it. Quote now to get started.

**Why Progressive?:** With on-water towing, fuel spill removal, mechanical breakdown coverage, and
more, you can float on without worry.

[Learn more about boat][34]

#### Get the coverage you need to keep your business growing

From general liability to cyber insurance, you can find the coverages you need to protect your
company from severe financial loss. Start a quote today and safeguard your business from the
unexpected.

[Learn more about business][35]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][36]

Your home's structure may be protected, but what about everything inside? With condo insurance, you

**Why Progressive?:** We cover your belongings, temporary living expenses, home upgrades, and more
so you don’t have to worry about gaps in coverage.

[Learn more about condo][38]

#### Safeguard your most valuable asset

Protect your home, belongings, and financial security with homeowners insurance. With a variety of
coverages, and plenty of ways to save, you can create a policy that keeps your home safe and fits
your budget. Get a quote today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can instantly compare rates and coverages from multiple companies
side-by-side to find the right policy for you.

[Learn more about homeowners][39]

#### Give your family the safety net they deserve

Term life insurance can provide you and your family with long-lasting financial security. You
determine how much coverage you need, how long you need it, who you’d like covered, and when you
pay—giving you control of your policy. Quote now to get started.

[Learn more about term life][40]

#### Build a mobile home policy that works for you

With a range of coverages and deductible options to choose from, you can easily create an insurance
policy that protects your mobile home and works with your budget. Start building your policy today.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer specialized protection to cover porches, garages, gazebos, and more.

[Learn more about mobile home][41]

If you enjoy the freedom of the open road, then you'll love the freedom of choice we give you with
our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all
repairs.

[Learn more about pet insurance][43]

With renters insurance, your belongings are protected whether they're in your apartment, backseat,

**Why Progressive?:** You can get a renters policy for less than $1 per day.^{‡‡}

[Learn more about renters][44]

covered.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

[ Download Now ][43]

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you
complete visibility into how threats can actually move through your hybrid environment, which
exposures matter most to your business, and proof that your controls are working as intended.

[ Watch the Video ][44]

## Protecting the world.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and
measurable operational value.

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

[READ THE REPORT][167]

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.

* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response

Everyone from civilians in active war zones, to CFOs of Fortune 100s, to your next door neighbor are
victimized for different insidious reasons.
[Comparison of images labeled as deepfake or real: a woman speaking before a blurred audience
labeled deepfake, a couple talking outdoors at a gathering labeled real, and a man surveying rubble
labeled deepfake.]
No one is safe because deepfakes are good, cheap, and easy to make.

For the last decade, the entire industry optimized for one thing:
[A man in a white polo shirt is looking at the camera outdoors with trees and grass in the
background; overlaid text says 'Upload image, video, or audio file' with an upload icon and a 'Done'
button.]
Making AI-generated media as human as possible.

Almost no one stopped to ask **what happens when synthetic media fools humans more often than not.**
[Split image of a woman labeled real and a man labeled fake with text indicating human detection has
50% accuracy.]
[Collage of tweets discussing deepfake and voice cloning scams, including a fake call from a fake
mom, deepfake senator video, voice biometric system bypass, and a $25M wire fraud with CFO voice
clone.][Side-by-side comparison labeling of two images as deepfake and one image as real, showing a

with the text 'Human detection: 50% accuracy' below.]
But we did.

From the beginning, Resemble AI built beloved voice AI models like Chatterbox with provenance and
detection in mind. That’s foundational to us and gives us a distinct advantage in detecting
deepfakes. The result is **the only platform that verifies and detects across voice, image and video
for total security.**

## EXPERT CYBERSECURITY SOLUTIONS PROVIDER FOR GROWING COMPANIES

WE PROTECT GREAT COMPANIES AND THEIR PEOPLE

Your organization is unique. But all too often, cost concerns force mid-market companies to settle
for cookie cutter solutions. Silent Sector provides unbiased vendor and technology-neutral
cybersecurity assessments, guidance, managed cybersecurity services, and program implementation to
keep your company compliant and ahead of the threats. We design solutions for mid-market and
emerging companies in the healthcare, financial services, technology, education, manufacturing, and
defense industries.

[An illustration of virtual data-1]

### Expertise Impact Methodology

Our experts become an extension of your organization

Silent Sector's unique Expertise Impact Model™ streamlines cost and response time by putting you in
direct contact with the experts you need.  Using an asymmetrical warfare approach based on US Army
Special Forces experience, our Expertise Impact Model maximizes capabilities of your internal and
external resources.  This force multiplication methodology also focuses on getting the most value
from your existing software and hardware.  It’s how Silent Sector delivers the high level of
proficiency typically only available to large enterprises, right-sized for the budgets of mid-market
and emerging organizations who need it most.

## **AI, Interactivity,**
