## **Content Protection**
## Watermarks

Our Award-winning watermark technology is the industry standard for movies, music and television.

## Setting the Standard

The motion picture industry implemented our content protection watermark as part of the Blu-ray Disc
standard.

The television industry selected our content measurement and enhancement watermark as part of the
next generation TV standard, ATSC 3.0.

The HbbTV Association adopted watermarking for inclusion within its “Application Discovery over
Broadband” specification.

## Interactivity

Aspect™ drives viewer engagement and revenue by delivering interactive and personalized television
with unparalleled reach. Working across all devices and distribution paths, including today’s ATSC
1.0 environment, Aspect powers leading experiences on par with digital platforms today.

[ Discover Aspect Interactivity ][12]

## AI / Provenance

Verance Authentication (VA) tackles the growing menace of AI-generated content and disinformation,
offering immediate credibility and validation. As up to 90% of online content may be artificial by
2026, Verance promotes authenticity across all media platforms, providing viewers the information
that they need to decide what information they can trust.

[ Discover Verance Authentication ][13]

## Content Protection

Cinavia® generates revenue by protecting your entertainment assets from piracy in the pre-release,
theatrical, and home video windows. Cinavia has been implemented by the major Hollywood studios, all
Blu-ray device manufacturers, and is an industry requirement for UHD/4K content.

[ Discover Cinavia ][14]

## Innovating Together

With decades of innovation, industry expertise, and dedication to our customers, Verance is your
natural partner for optimizing the value of media and audiences.

[ About Verance ][15]

Explore Our Communities
Where the Human Spirit Flourishes

## Why Watermark?

We believe in the power of the human spirit. We believe every person — no matter where they come
from, how they look, what they believe, who they love, what they can do, or how old they are —
deserves a life filled with purpose, possibility, and joy.

With passion and purpose, for more than 30 years, we remain relentless in our pursuit of
transforming senior living, with a keen focus on the living part. What makes you thrive? We really
want to know.

[Learn More About Watermark ][331]

## Our Stories

“[The Watermark at Bellevue], thank you, thank you for the kindness, care, wisdom, patience, and
most important the love that you’ve been guiding my family through this process of transitioning my
mother from independent care to memory care. We are so thankful to you for the level of detail and
attention that you provide to all the residents. We were so scared to transition my Mom, but the
Watermark has been incredible guiding us lovingly through this process. The food is incredible, as
well. They have the best chefs that we could ask for. They are also the most kind chefs ever. I
truly believe that one of the criteria for being hired at Watermark is that you have to have a heart
of gold. Each one of the people my Mom has encountered has been amazing - Patti, Alicia, Mike,
Hugo…each and everyone of the faces my Mom sees there has a kind attitude and we can’t thank them
enough for doing what they do. It’s been a blessing to incorporate our family into their family.
Thank you Watermark! You are forever in our hearts 💕”

“I moved my mother ... late last year from an assisted living in the Houston area. I didn’t know
what we had been missing! Watermark is amazing. Very open, modern, bright-looking accommodations and
overall atmosphere … Mom likes the food so much she has canceled outside lunches with me … I have
definitely seen my mom thrive and am so happy with my decision to move her here.”

“ ... a magnificent setting, you’d think you’re going to a 5 star Ritz Carlton hotel. The staff is
friendly, sweet, & very patient, as well as very well equipped for their job, my water aerobics
instructor has 3 degrees! Friday & Saturday night dinners at the Mark are excellent, all the food is
cooked to perfection. Come join us!”

Where the Human Spirit Flourishes

## Why Watermark?

We believe in the power of the human spirit. We believe every person — no matter where they come
from, how they look, what they believe, who they love, what they can do, or how old they are —
deserves a life filled with purpose, possibility, and joy.

With passion and purpose, for more than 30 years, we remain relentless in our pursuit of
transforming senior living, with a keen focus on the living part. What makes you thrive? We really
want to know.

## Our Stories

“[The Watermark at Bellevue], thank you, thank you for the kindness, care, wisdom, patience, and
most important the love that you’ve been guiding my family through this process of transitioning my
mother from independent care to memory care. We are so thankful to you for the level of detail and
attention that you provide to all the residents. We were so scared to transition my Mom, but the
Watermark has been incredible guiding us lovingly through this process. The food is incredible, as
well. They have the best chefs that we could ask for. They are also the most kind chefs ever. I
truly believe that one of the criteria for being hired at Watermark is that you have to have a heart
of gold. Each one of the people my Mom has encountered has been amazing - Patti, Alicia, Mike,
Hugo…each and everyone of the faces my Mom sees there has a kind attitude and we can’t thank them
enough for doing what they do. It’s been a blessing to incorporate our family into their family.
Thank you Watermark! You are forever in our hearts 💕”

“I moved my mother ... late last year from an assisted living in the Houston area. I didn’t know
what we had been missing! Watermark is amazing. Very open, modern, bright-looking accommodations and
overall atmosphere … Mom likes the food so much she has canceled outside lunches with me … I have
definitely seen my mom thrive and am so happy with my decision to move her here.”

“ ... a magnificent setting, you’d think you’re going to a 5 star Ritz Carlton hotel. The staff is
friendly, sweet, & very patient, as well as very well equipped for their job, my water aerobics
instructor has 3 degrees! Friday & Saturday night dinners at the Mark are excellent, all the food is
cooked to perfection. Come join us!”

# Verification API for AI apps and agents

LLMs make things up. We check their work against real sources and return citations with confidence
scores. Works with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or whatever model you're building on.

[Hero Background]
[Nielsen Marketing Report]

Proof for every damn thing

[Arrow]
Verify

Features

## Built to verify, extract, and cite. So your AI apps and agents work with facts, not
## hallucinations.

[Pinpointed source extraction]

### Pinpointed source extraction

Pull the exact passage from each source that backs up a claim. Ready for research, due diligence, or
agent pipelines.

[Reverse citation search]

### Reverse citation search

Find out who's citing or supporting your content across the web. Useful for competitive intel and
market research.

[Citation classification]

### Citation classification

Sort every citation by source type: journals, news, government records, industry reports. Know where
each fact comes from.

Source Integrity

Evidence Strength

[Credibility Score]

96%

Fact Consistency

Domain Credibility

### Credibility Scoring

Score how much each source can be trusted before your team or AI agent acts on it.

[Bring your own data]

### Bring your own data

Upload your own data. Internal reports, knowledge bases, business docs. It stays encrypted and
indexed for your team only.

[Security & compliance]

### Security & compliance

Built for regulated industries. Encryption at rest, we don't store your queries, and we're SOC 2
ready.

How it works

## How we lock in credibility

### Trusted data ingestion
